WITH cd_filtered AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd_education_status = 'College'
),
p_filtered AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM promotion
    WHERE (p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N')
),
d_filtered AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
)
SELECT 
    item.i_item_id,
    AVG(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
    AVG(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
    AVG(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
    AVG(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM 
    store_sales
JOIN 
    cd_filtered ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_filtered.cd_demo_sk
JOIN 
    p_filtered ON store_sales.ss_promo_sk = p_filtered.p_promo_sk
JOIN 
    d_filtered ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = d_filtered.d_date_sk
JOIN 
    item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
GROUP BY 
    item.i_item_id
ORDER BY 
    item.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
